On 4 Feb 2013, at 4:27 PM, Joscha Bach wrote:

Thank you very much for that offer, Stephen! — I live in Berlin, though, so meeting up in person will require
a bit of organizational effort. It is quite likely that I will be in the area again soon.
I am very interested in integrating cognition, ie building cognitive architectures, understanding the nature and
organization of mental representation on a functional (not necessarily neurobiological) level, and somewhere
down the road I would like to learn more about the emergence of visual/perceptual grammars, mental
simulation, and the genesis of language. I think I have some basic understanding how to build a
computational model of motivation (helpful for attaching relevance to mental content, and providing
reinforcement signals for open-ended learning, social interaction and exploration), and how to conceive of
affect as a configuration of cognitive modulators. (I wrote a cognitive architecture, MicroPsi, and a book on
the topic, called "Principles of Synthetic Intelligence", from OUP.)
Cheers,
Joscha

Thanks, Jeffrey!
